title: Medusa Review (2026)
intro: Medusa is evaluated here as an open-source commerce platform (plugin/core + extensions) — Medusa is a headless, JavaScript/TypeScript open-source commerce platform. MIT OSS self-host is free for production. Medusa Cloud (first-party): Develop from $29/mo, Launch from $99/mo (highlighted), Scale from $299/mo, Enterprise custom — no GMV percentage tax on published Cloud tiles. Landscape open-source peer — WooCommerce keeps the cluster award (8.1). Research grounded 2026-08-18 from medusajs.com/pricing. This review uses SoftwareGlimpse’s Ecommerce methodology (ease of use, storefront/commerce fit, catalog & order depth, checkout conversion, integrations, omnichannel/POS, scalability, value, AI), scoring products inside their job cluster rather than against unrelated peers. It is based on first-party research, not hands-on lab testing.
summary: Choose Medusa when you want headless JS commerce with a free OSS core and approachable Cloud tiles — not when you need WordPress-native WooCommerce or Shopify’s theme ecosystem.
verdict: Choose Medusa when you want headless JS commerce with a free OSS core and approachable Cloud tiles — not when you need WordPress-native WooCommerce or Shopify’s theme ecosystem. Consider Saleor for GraphQL-native Cloud with GMV bands; WooCommerce for WordPress; Shopify for hosted SaaS themes/apps. Scores reflect first-party documentation as of 2026-08-17 — not hands-on product testing. Confirm current packaging, minimums and usage rates on the vendor site before purchase.

criterionAssessments.rationale: Developer-friendly JS modules beat Magento for many teams; still not a Shopify theme admin.
Core job is headless open-source commerce. Landscape peer — WooCommerce keeps the award.
Solid modular catalog and order workflows for DTC/headless builds.
Checkout is composed with Stripe-class gateways — quality depends on your storefront.
Module ecosystem and JS stack integrate well with modern web tooling.
Launch/Scale/Enterprise cover growth; very large programmes may still evaluate Saleor Cloud or commercetools.
Free OSS plus Cloud from $29/$99 without GMV tax is competitive for headless teams.
Vendor AI narratives are stronger than classic PHP carts, secondary to the commerce engine.
